## Purpose
A reusable starting point for both Sekalum Discover selection variants:

Variant A: set Provider Filter to Twitch or OpenAI API for local filtering inside the Sekalum node.
Variant B: leave Provider Filter empty to return one item per Credential, then use Choose Provider.

The workflow demonstrates deterministic post-Discovery selection. It does not depend on item 0 or item 1. The optional provider request remains disabled so you can add your own downstream API call when ready.

## Prerequisites and setup
- Set CREDENTIAL_HUB_BASE_URL and CREDENTIAL_HUB_API_TOKEN.
- Make sure an administrator activated the credentials and created matching Consumer API grants.

Variant A: enter Twitch or OpenAI API in Provider Filter. The node performs the unchanged Discover request and filters the public results locally.

Variant B: leave Provider Filter empty. Discover returns one n8n item per available Credential. Choose Provider compares the stable public field `metadata.displayName`; it never relies on result order.

The Consumer API remains unchanged. To select a different provider after Discover, edit the Switch rule or add another provider branch.

## Trust boundary
Sekalum resolves only explicitly authorized Secret fields. Only the downstream provider request should receive resolved values. Do not expose resolved secrets in logs, workflow outputs or stored executions.

## Selection branches
- Twitch → `credentialKey` + `accessToken` → Resolve
- OpenAI → `credentialKey` + `apiKey` → Resolve
- Other / inspect → safe error; no Resolve request

The selected entry is carried to Resolve through `{{$json.credentialKey}}`.
